witness_description: At X=1, take alpha(1)=0. The distinct assignments G_A(1)=-1 and G_B(1)=0 both produce F(1)=alpha(1)G(1)=0.
refutation_explanation: Because the same F(1)=0 arises from two different values of G(1), F does not determine G when alpha(1)=0. Moreover, the quoted inverse coefficient beta(1)=1/alpha(1) is undefined for this witness, so recovery cannot dispense with alpha(1) being nonzero.
search_space: Exhaustively checked X=1 with alpha(1) in {-1,0,1} and every ordered pair of distinct values G_A(1), G_B(1) in {-1,0,1}, in fixed lexicographic order, for equal resulting F(1).
